scope: Build the smallest deterministic, persistence-agnostic WAIT/HOLD/Wake contract for Frankenstein 2.0. It may represent an explicit hold checkpoint, typed caller-supplied wake conditions and explicit observations, then deterministically classify whether a condition matches under exact state-id/generation/state-digest fences. It must not read clocks/sensors/UnifiedDB itself, schedule processes, infer events/world facts, auto-resume a goal, choose Persistent Pulse actions, invoke providers/tools, authorize effects, or mint completion. Goal-lifecycle integration remains external until F2-WP-204 is accepted. Source plus deterministic tests and public repository CI only; no VPS/physical-GRID10/whole-system credit.
